why: B asserts the construction for every covering functor f : D → C, including D = ∅, which the text's Definition 8.5.5 allows. As its author predicted, B does not hold as we read it. not_B uses D = Discrete PEmpty, G = Unit, L_C(⋆) = ℝ and L_D empty; f is a covering functor (a bijection of empty sets), but Y = ∅, so no functor Y → X can be surjective onto U(x) = ℝ. The project assumes [Nonempty D] in proposition_8_5_7 and records exactly this failure in A (geometricLiftFunctor_surjective_iff: F is surjective iff D ≠ ∅ or U(x) = ∅). So A ⇒ B is false (not_A_to_B), and B ⇒ A holds only ex falso. The exact difference is the hypothesis D ≠ ∅. BRepaired is B with [Nonempty D], and A ⇒ BRepaired is proved, using A's proposition_8_5_7. For EY it takes the project's geometricLiftSource, whose object and morphism types are B's Σ-types on the nose. For EX it takes Chapter 7's actionEpGroupoid for G itself: the project's geometricLiftTarget has morphisms ULift G × U(x), while B fixes G × U(x). The functor is the project's F without ULift (functorG). Conditions (1), (2) of the proper covering carry over verbatim; (3) is transported along ((g, z), y) ↦ ((up g, z), y) between the two fibred-product sub-M-polyfolds. The IsModelB summand clauses use Sigma.mk with inverse τ(y)⁻¹ ∘ F. BRepaired ⇒ A was not attempted (stopped and diagnosed). Eleven of A's thirteen conjuncts are lemmas about the project's own constructions, in more generality than B covers: arbitrary, possibly infinite D (isLocalScDiffeo_ySrc/yTgt, isScSmoothCompSheet_y), no covering hypothesis, and D = ∅ in surjective_iff. Even proposition_8_5_7 for the project's F would need the proper covering transported from B's unspecified model, through EY.PObj ≅ yObjPolyfold (pinned down by B's summand clauses) and G vs ULift G. That is glue effort, not a mathematical gap.
B_issue: B formalizes the proposition for every covering functor, D = ∅ included, which the author flags as false. That makes B false (not_B), which matches the project: proposition_8_5_7 assumes [Nonempty D], and geometricLiftFunctor_surjective_iff records why. BRepaired in the Items file (B with [Nonempty D]) is implied by A.
intended: BRepaired (B with [Nonempty D]): A_to_BRepaired proved (rt_check_fields OK, uses A's proposition_8_5_7); BRepaired_to_A not proved: A ⊋ BRepaired in generality (lemma-level facts about the project's constructions for arbitrary D), effort only for proposition_8_5_7 itself.

Both pass it, reaching only those four banned theorems, only through Polyfold.geometricLiftSource and Polyfold.geometricLiftFunctor. A_to_BRepaired does not reach proposition_8_5_7, geometricLiftFunctor_isScDiffeo_fibredMap or isScSmoothMap_fibredInv as constants.
